note: What each acceptance layer can actually show today. 'full' means a real, repeatable run exists for that layer; 'partial' means one side of it ran and a named piece is still missing; 'none' means nothing has been run. A layer is never marked 'full' because its code exists.

DB.note: Synthetic acceptance on a real isolated PostgreSQL plus a full legacy-copy migration replay.

DOMAIN.note: Domain rules are exercised through their own SQL functions; the content inside them is not approved.

SECURITY.note: RLS, zero client grants, owner and composite guards are asserted in every phase probe and over real HTTP for P05.

API.note: Real PostgREST calls against the isolated stack.

CONCURRENCY.note: Parallel sessions against the same isolated database.

FAULT_INJECTION.note: Crash, lost response and retry paths on the isolated stack.

IMPORT.blocker: No safe parser and no row-scale run; the equipment import target does not exist.

DOCUMENT.blocker: No render worker, so no PDF or XLSX has ever been produced or compared.

STORAGE.blocker: P00 restored and hash-checked 588 objects, including signed downloads. New domain bucket policies and measured RPO/RTO acceptance remain open.

FILE_SECURITY.blocker: No antivirus or parser sandbox and no positive DOC or XLS security fixtures.

AUTH.blocker: The OTP and recovery purpose coordinator, account linking and MFA variations were never run.

NOTIFICATION.blocker: No real APNs, FCM or email provider has ever been called.

REMINDER.blocker: No physical device acceptance for permission, token, time zone, reboot or Focus.

NOTES.blocker: Encrypted native note queues exist. Offline reminder mutations and second-device conflict acceptance on real hardware remain open.

BILLING.blocker: No RevenueCat or webhook adapter writes evidence, and the access authority is still the legacy helper.

CAMPAIGN.blocker: No real qualification producer, catalogue adapter or send. V5 fixes 7-day gifts and 20% discounts; annual banking, collision, limits, timing and store publication decisions remain open.

OBSERVABILITY.blocker: No client telemetry producer exists, so no real technical event has ever been recorded.

NETWORK_PRIVACY.blocker: The rules are enforced in the database, but no network inspection of a real install has been done.

DESIGN.blocker: No English pass on a real device, no VoiceOver run, and the app root has not moved to the new shell.

NATIVE_E2E.blocker: Only the P05 personnel and directory flows have a real native end-to-end run; every other domain has none.

DELETION.blocker: Account deletion across the new domains was never designed or built.

COMPATIBILITY.blocker: The sixteen old binary and new backend combinations have never been run.

STORE_QA.blocker: No store spike on either store; no sandbox or production purchase, offer signature or offer token has ever been exercised.

ADMIN.blocker: The operations panel repository was deliberately not touched; no scoped page or Playwright flow exists.

OPERATIONS.blocker: The support chain has no client producer and the panel has no diagnosis surface, so the operator story was never walked.

CROSS_LAYER_ACCEPTANCE.blocker: The integrated cross-domain acceptance layer has no scoped proof yet. P05 native-to-server acceptance exists under NATIVE_E2E and must not be erased or extrapolated to all domains.
